positions.name: ProbeArtifactCarriesAssertion
positions.frame: what is the relationship between this probe memory and the behavioral claim it exists to carry?
positions.why: src-1 states the behavioral claim (e2e suite asserts enrollment-on-save) and src-2 explicitly frames the probe memory's entire purpose as carrying that same assertion ('that assertion' refers back to src-1). Both are flat, unhedged, present-tense, matter-of-fact/technical-register claims (per the directional reads: claim-level conviction, informational power, competence value, realis/concrete temporal) — the pair coheres as one artifact-and-its-stated-purpose unit rather than two independent claims. No tension to narrate; the two expressions are complementary halves of one self-describing probe.
